about: Camera spots for the walkable outer road, part 2 (S4b, u 12600-15500), in the one world frame (metres: X east, D north, H height; facing_deg 0 = +X east, 90 = north). Everything placed in the world comes from the scroll map through layout.json (tools/map_layout.mjs); this file only says where the camera can stand.

seam.about: just east of the part 1 seam (u 12600; X 55.4 here), looking up the road between the two palm-covered carts

carts.about: the two palm-covered family carts (大棕盖车), the sedan chair set down, the shop hall with its tables

crowd.about: the crowd round the seated man under the big roof's mat awning, the crowd shop and the gnarled trees

wheelwright.about: the wheelwright at the wheel lying on the ground, the pole frame with its basket, the timber, the shed

top_street.about: the top street: the eating houses, the stall, the pack mules

tea_house.about: the tea house's open hall under its fringed mat canopy, its seated customers

moorings_bank.about: on the bank above the gangplank, looking out over the moored boats (the raft, bows to the bank)

moorings_road.about: from the road by the tea house's east end, north over the bank to the big cabin boat and the raft

road_east.about: the road's east end at the S3 seam: the big willow, the low house, the long south hall

moorings_post.about: on the bank by the mooring post: the big cabin boat's bow and its ropes, the raft beyond

cove.about: the cove's north-west corner: the round-sterned boat, the small boat along the far bank, the far bank in the mist
